title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.3.7
subtitle: Original render output and a leaner Companion.

highlights.title: Unmodified Render Output
highlights.description: Cloth NeXt no longer embeds an invisible provenance watermark into rendered images.

highlights.title: Leaner Companion
highlights.description: Watermark models and decoder dependencies have been removed from the bundled application.

improvements.text: Welcome, What's New, and changelog access remain available in Preferences.
Viewport state continues to reset safely when opening another Blender file.

fixes.text: Rebake and Recovery preview show the current simulation while preserving the previous cache.
Bounded cache cleanup and reliable onboarding startup and reload handling.
